title: CEFR Multilevel Mock - Writing - Variant C

parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions: Part 1 has TWO tasks, Task 1.1 and Task 1.2. Both tasks are about the same situation. Read the message below and answer both tasks. Write your answers on the answer sheet.

questions.q:
You received a message from the manager of the Green Steps Travel Club, which you join every Saturday.

Dear Member,
From next month the club plans to make two changes. First, our Saturday walks in the Alanbek Hills will be replaced by a two-hour minibus tour, because some members say the hills are too far to reach on foot. Second, the yearly fee will rise from 80,000 so'm to 140,000 so'm to pay for the minibus and the driver.
Nodira Ergasheva,
The Club Manager

WRITING TASK 1.1
Write a short letter to your friend who also attends this club with you. Explain the situation about the possible changes and tell them how you feel about it.
Write about 50 words.
questions.topic: Writing - Informal letter to a friend

questions.q:
You received a message from the manager of the Green Steps Travel Club, which you join every Saturday.

Dear Member,
From next month the club plans to make two changes. First, our Saturday walks in the Alanbek Hills will be replaced by a two-hour minibus tour, because some members say the hills are too far to reach on foot. Second, the yearly fee will rise from 80,000 so'm to 140,000 so'm to pay for the minibus and the driver.
Nodira Ergasheva,
The Club Manager

WRITING TASK 1.2
Write a letter to the club manager.
- give your opinion about replacing the Saturday walks with a minibus tour
- explain what you think about the higher yearly fee
- suggest what the club should do instead
Write about 120-150 words.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: Part 2 has ONE task. Read the question and post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write your answer on the answer sheet.

questions.q:
You are participating in an online discussion for learners.
The question is: Some people believe that cheap flights should be taxed much more heavily so that fewer people travel abroad and the air stays cleaner. Others say this would only stop ordinary families from seeing the world. What is your opinion?
Post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180-200 words.
